code.text: Pediatric oral health assessment findings (well-child visit)

component.valueString: Significant plaque-induced gingivitis observed on examination.
Two lower central (baby) incisors lost: one site remains edentulous; one adult tooth partially erupted.
Patient reports pain around the area of the missing teeth.
No established dental home; patient has never seen a dental provider.

note.text: Oral health assessment performed by Dr. Smith as part of the well-child protocol. Wrapped for transmission with the referral (DocumentReference) and included in the Interaction 2 pre-encounter records bundle. Findings are captured as components with text values; no LOINC code is asserted for the overall pediatric oral health assessment (text-only per project verification discipline).
